_what: One plain summary per published report (spec 125): four or five points, about 100 words, no engine words, what was tested, what was found and what the report does not show. Rendered by scripts/site-chrome.js tldrCard as the first element of the TL;DR fence, under the report title. Each point names its sources, each a public file whose text carries the quote verbatim (HTML: tags removed, entities decoded, white space collapsed; other files: the raw text). A {name} is read from the file its row names under values, never typed.
